Input:Account.title: Account
Input:Account.description: The Salesforce Account record to summarise. Resolve the account from the user's request — use Get_Account_Details first if the Account ID is not already in context, then pass the returned Account record as this input.

outputLanguage.title: Output language
outputLanguage.description: Optional. Specify the response language using the appropriate two-character language code or five-character locale code (for example, en_US, en_GB, es, es_MX).

isPreviewOnly.title: Preview Only
isPreviewOnly.description: Resolves the prompt template without generating an LLM response.
